copy.windowIntro: The sign-in stopped working. Writing carries on: the draft below is still being saved on this computer. The alert sits in the corner and after the notes' name in Files, and both open the same card.
copy.cardsIntro: Every cause the alert covers, as its card. Hover, keyboard focus or a press on either alert icon opens it. Sync starts by itself only when nothing here could be lost.
copy.statesIntro: The corner and the Files header in each state. Normal and offline states have no alert; only a problem shows it.

body.text: The river was higher than last week, and the heron was back on the far bank before eight.
Notes for the weekend: check the tide table, bring the long lens, and leave before the fog lifts.
The path by the reeds is flooded again, so the far hide is only reachable from the north gate.
A pair of kingfishers crossed twice, low and fast, too quick for a photograph but not for a note.
Written after the sign-in stopped working: this paragraph is saved on this computer and backs up once you sign in again.
